task: Click omits an explicitly empty string default from option help. When show_default is enabled, display that empty default clearly. Preserve help for nonempty strings, numeric defaults, omitted defaults and boolean flags.

commands: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');import click;ctx=click.Context(click.Command('cli'));h=lambda **kw:click.Option(['--limit'],**kw).get_help_record(ctx)[1];assert any(marker in h(default='',show_default=True) for marker in ('[default: ""]', "[default: '']", '[default: (empty)]', '[default: (empty string)]'));assert '[default: text]' in h(default='text',show_default=True);assert '[default: 3]' in h(default=3,show_default=True);assert '[default:' not in h(show_default=True);assert '[default:' not in h(default='',show_default=False);assert '[default:' not in h(is_flag=True,default=False,show_default=True);assert '[default: True]' in h(is_flag=True,default=True,show_default=True);assert '[default: (custom)]' in h(default='',show_default='custom')
